description: web_reg_async_attributes(Pattern=Poll) turns the next step into a background conversation: the status URL is polled every PollIntervalMs while the script continues (here, to web_sync), the registered JSON extraction applies to each poll response, web_sync waits until a poll saves JobStatus=done, and web_stop_async ends the series before the next step. VuGen's empty RequestCB and ResponseBodyBufferCB stubs need nothing; the ResponseCB body (lr_save_string) runs after each poll response.
source: VuGen 26.1 Function Reference: web_reg_async_attributes (ID, Pattern, URL, PollIntervalMs, RequestCB, ResponseCB, ResponseBodyBufferCB), web_stop_async, web_sync (ParamValueEquals, Timeout); Asynchronous communication: callbacks in AsyncCallbacks.c.
